newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian oil firm lowers dividend.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian oil firm lowers dividend.

text.p: Extracted Oils and Derivatives will pay an annual dividend of 2.625 pounds a share for 1995/6, down from 4.48 pounds in 1994/5, brokers said on Sunday.
Net attributable profits fell to 18.668 million pounds ($5.5 million) from 24.809 million in the previous year, they said. The years end on June 30.
Shares in the partially privatised company traded on Sunday at 32.05 pounds, compared with about 45.00 pounds a year ago.
The company makes cooking oil, margarine, soap, animal feed and detergents.
